about: The answer key for the values-extract samples: the values a correct run reads from each record, with the quote that supports each, and the values it must leave out.

All text is invented: the products, their codes and their data sheets. make-samples.mjs checks that every quote is in its record's text as written, and that a number's quote holds the number as the text states it.

Numbers compare as numbers, in the property's unit. stated gives the number and unit as the text states them when the property holds another unit: 800 mm is 80 for depth_cm. A text value compares in lower case, trimmed, against accept. A run may quote more or less of the text, as long as its quote is in the text and holds the evidence.
leave_out lists values a correct run does not write. With value null, the run writes no value for that property at all.

Two values go to review before they are written: the width of R-3, whose quote states no unit, and, with the mock models, the width of K-17, whose quote says about (the mocks give it a support of 0.6, below the default gate 0.8).

install.context: Product data sheets of office furniture and small appliances, in English and German.

records.name: T-160
records.case: Sizes in m and mm, which the run converts to cm, an accessory of another material, and no color.

leave_out.reason: Steel is the material of the cable tray, an accessory.

records.name: LP-7
records.case: The only size in the text belongs to an accessory, the clamp.

leave_out.reason: 6 x 4 cm is the size of the clamp, an accessory. The lamp's size is left to the maker (size as the maker states).
6 x 4 cm is the size of the clamp, an accessory. The lamp's size is left to the maker (size as the maker states).

records.name: K-17
records.case: An approximate width (about 22 cm) is still the item's width. The mock models give its quote a support below the default gate, so a run with them puts it in review.

records.name: MS-40
records.case: A variant that holds only under a condition (For two screens).

leave_out.reason: The width of the version for two screens, which holds only under that condition.

records.name: R-3
records.case: A text in German. The width states no unit (Breite 43), so the run asks a person to confirm it. The second size is a height, and the text gives no depth.

leave_out.reason: 60 cm is the height (Höhe). The text gives no depth.
